limits: Each family appears in two fit-fold evaluations and once out of fold. Pooled fit evaluations are dependent diagnostics, not independent games. Uses fixed E89 terminal labels and saved heads. Hindsight scope maxima are not executable policies, learned win rates, or population upper bounds.

interpretation.supported: Saved heads improve the same families used to fit them; this improvement does not transfer to the assigned out-of-fold families. Only seven out of4732 validation card offers lack support; no relic offer does. The current two-choice hindsight maximum is347/1536 fit families.
interpretation.not_established: This does not isolate representation quality, label noise, data scale or optimization as a unique cause. The hindsight maximum is specific to these seed families, two choices and fixed continuation, not a population or full-policy bound.
excluded_next_actions: Do not claim changing only these two choices can reach50 percent on this fixed fit cohort.
Do not pool duplicated fit-fold rows as independent games.
